sources.title: Urban Sound Tagging using Convolutional Neural Networks
sources.snippet: We applied this system to the task of Urban Sound Tagging, part of the DCASE 2019. The objective was to label different sources of noise from raw audio data. A modified form of MobileNetV2, a convolutional neural network (CNN) model was trained to classify both coarse and fine tags jointly.
